tasks.spec: Role: PE-CC-DEV operations reviewer. Review the PEC-77 planning-only principal/resource registry against its exact Linear acceptance: unique stable persona/resource records and fail-closed mismatch tests. Production activation and runtime integration belong to blocked downstream PEC-78 and are expressly excluded; do not fail PEC-77 merely because no production consumer exists. Read ../../../../../../agents/registry/named-agent-principals.json, both validators, tests, agent profiles, docs/74, and the stated scope. Own only review.md. Do not access networks or systems. Required headings: Verdict, Registry Coverage, Mismatch Tests, P0/P1 Findings, Authorization Boundary, Next Gate. Evaluate canonical roster/order, profile drift, Ops Conductor separation, credential-reference claims, capability/default-deny fence, resource-status vocabulary, predecessor declarations, and whether all current states deny effects. The checker is verdict-neutral.
tasks.verified: Operations review plus executable mismatch tests validate canonical identity/resource coverage and fail-closed behavior.
